_note: Brainrot / meme SFX registry. URLs are best-effort public mirrors (myinstants.com direct MP3 paths); the fetcher reports clearly on 404 / network errors. User can override per-name via FCP_SFX_DIR=<dir> env var (local file <dir>/<name>.<ext> takes precedence over the cataloged URL).

vine-boom.description: Classic Vine boom — deep bass thud, comedic emphasis on a punchline or reveal.

faaa-peter.description: Peter Griffin (Family Guy) extended 'FAAAA' shock yell. Used over a reaction shot.

bruh.description: Soundboard 'BRUH' — short male voice, deadpan reaction.

discord-ping.description: Discord notification ping. Used as cut-marker or alert SFX.

airhorn.description: Mlg airhorn — sustained dub-style horn, comedic peak.

sad-violin.description: Sad-violin meme phrase — solo violin descending line over a failure beat.

bonk.description: Bonk hammer — single dry thud, slapstick.

to-be-continued.description: JoJo 'To Be Continued' arrow + Roundabout intro. Used over a freeze-frame ending.

error-windows.description: Windows XP error chime — comedic mistake or denial cue.

mario-jump.description: Mario jump SFX — short ascending boop. Used over an upward motion.

minecraft-villager.description: Minecraft villager 'hmm' — flat low grunt, used over a thinking shot.

wii-shop.description: Wii Shop Channel music — short loop of the iconic ragtime piano.

nope.description: Cartoon 'NOPE' — single male voice rejection. Used over a denial reaction.

siren-alarm.description: Tornado siren / alert klaxon — used to escalate urgency or stakes.
